requiredFindings.location: d5/PLAN-r4.md:184-193,345 (LD-D5-6 roots/classification and D5-0 build-root controls)
requiredFindings.finding: With build = false, the implicit build.rs ceases to be a production root. The gate rule can then classify a zero-production-path region as test code vacuously, and the fallback for unknown or unresolved analysis does not cover a successfully resolved but rootless source. The disabled-target control covers only a file also reached by another production path, not a dormant build.rs/helper with no alternative edge.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Define every in-scope source region with no resolved root path as non-exempt or as a structural-check failure, and require a nonempty resolved path before a gate can prove a test exemption. Add a build = false package whose otherwise-unreachable build.rs and helper contain a forbidden spawn and environment read, with no alternative production edge, and require both owner tools to refuse them; retain the mixed-path control separately.

rulings.Q10: REQUIRED-FINDINGS: Boolean path conditions, inline/item gates, mixed paths and unknown syntax are corrected, and enabled implicit/custom build roots are non-exempt. The build = false zero-root case remains ambiguous and lacks a direct control, so Q10 is not yet accepted.
